notes: The italicized let him do it is added; as at 12:6 and 12:7, rule 103 is the governing citation, μεταδιδούς having spent its English on that giveth.
ἐλεῶν → that showeth mercy heads on mercy, the corpus spending the mercy word on this stem while showeth is the empty support verb (rules 17, 91).

Where the ASV writes a possessive (his exhorting) the article takes it under rule 20's second arm; where it writes no determiner (liberality, diligence, cheerfulness) no Greek article stands at all, so nothing is emptied.
